================================================================================
Merge with update and insert
================================================================================

MERGE INTO people
    USING (SELECT unnest([3, 1]) AS id, unnest(['Sarah', 'John']) AS name, unnest([95_000.0, 105_000.0]) AS salary) AS upserts
    ON (upserts.id = people.id)
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT;

---

(source_file
  (merge_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))

================================================================================
Merge with conditions and actions
================================================================================

MERGE INTO people p
    USING deletes d
    USING (id)
    WHEN MATCHED AND d.flag THEN DELETE
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET salary = d.salary, name = d.name
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN DELETE
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET AND d.id > 0 THEN INSERT (id, name) VALUES (d.id, d.name)
    RETURNING merge_action, *;

---

(source_file
  (merge_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (identifier)
    (table_reference
      (object_reference
        (identifier))
      (identifier))
    (column_list
      (identifier))
    (merge_when_clause
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (assignment
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier)))
      (assignment
        (column_reference
          (identifier))
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))))
    (merge_when_clause)
    (merge_when_clause
      (binary_expression
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (operator)
        (number))

        (identifier))

================================================================================
Merge with stars, BY NAME, DO NOTHING and ERROR
================================================================================

MERGE INTO t USING s ON t.id = s.id
    WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
    WHEN MATCHED AND s.x THEN UPDATE BY NAME
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT BY NAME *
    WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.y THEN INSERT *
    WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.z THEN INSERT DEFAULT VALUES
    WHEN MATCHED AND s.w THEN DO NOTHING
    WHEN MATCHED AND s.v THEN ERROR 'no'
    WHEN MATCHED THEN ERROR;

---

(source_file
  (merge_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (table_reference
      (object_reference
        (identifier)))
    (binary_expression
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (operator)
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause)
    (merge_when_clause
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause)
    (merge_when_clause
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (string))
    (merge_when_clause)))
